name: UpdateGatewayDomain

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type. Valid values:
HTTPS
HTTP
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The ID of the domain name to be updated
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_unique_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP/2. Valid values:
`open`: enables HTTP/2.
`close`: disables HTTP/2.
`globalConfig`: uses the global configuration
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启`Http2`。
`open`：开启`Http2`。
`close`：关闭`Http2`。
`globalConfig`：使用全局配置
parameters.name: http2

fields.help_en:
The cipher suite configuration type. Valid values:
DEFAULT
CUSTOM
fields.help_zh:
加密套件配置类型选择。

DEFAULT

CUSTOM
fields.name: config_type

fields.help_en: The list of cipher suite names
fields.name: tls_cipher_suites

parameters.help_en:
The language of the returned information. Valid values:
zh: Chinese (default).
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable Web Application Firewall (WAF) for the gateway domain name
parameters.help_zh: 是否为网关域名启用 Web 应用防火墙
parameters.name: enable_waf

Success.description_en:
The request result. Valid values:
`true`: The request is successful.
`false`: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求结果，取值如下：
`true`：请求成功。
`false`：请求失败
